name: submit_intake
description: Submit the completed Monkyfi Connect intake so Dante can follow up. Call once you have at least name, work email, and company. Never send date of birth, age, home address, national ID, passwords, or end-customer PII.

request_body_schema.description: Connect short-qualification fields collected on the call

phone.description: Optional phone or WhatsApp number. Empty string if they skipped it.

operation_type.description: Fibra/ISP, Mobile/MVNO, Subsea, Data Center, MSP, Enterprise IT, or Other

services.description: Monkyfi Connect services of interest, comma-separated

situation.description: Optional short description of their situation
